Name: CP - Futa Centaur Haley Horse Replacer
Author: rafinha20041
Description:
So I was looking for a Skimpy horse replacer, and I found the Ponygirl [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/615]Haley [/url]by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/MortaliB/mods?gameId=1303]MortaliB[/url]/[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10355]Sophia[/url] by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/1238942]YukoValis[/url], and then subsequently [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/4955733]ColonolNutty[/url]'s "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/840]CN Futanari Human Farm Animals[/url]" Which possesses a futa versions of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/1238942]YukoValis[/url] human farm animals, of which he has some 6 or 7 of. I was however rather dissatisfied with the sprites, so I went onto looking at centaur girls and found [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/155028423]sunnycud[/url]'s "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17515]SCUD Busty Centaur Haley[/url]" alas twas not a futa, and the horse parts left me rather dissatisfied too but it had really neat boob physics when you rode her, so I decided that I would do it myself. I got sunny's permission to modify his sprites and gut his mod and got to work.

This mod still has the boob physics, but I also changed the hair shape and made it shimmer around as you move, the tail also has Haley colored hair and added length instead of the normal horse sprite one, not only that but the tail has physics in all directions you move, I removed the saddle so that alone made it look much better, changed the running animation a fair bit so that when you run right or left her tits pop out and shake about, her huge horsecock does that too. I also made an idle where she cums, her boobs squirt milk too, it came out (lol) pretty decently for my first ever pixel-art and mod. 

Now, you can download it on android! Will it work? Yeah.

P.S. GIFS of all the movements and Motions on the media section, including the new carrot eating anim.

This mod requires Content Patcher and SMAPI, if you have that just drop the file into your mods folder.
